generatedProse.practice-connection: From here, reflecting on experience is something you practise right across the School of Sport and beyond. Every placement log, every coaching reflection, every project review and the continuing professional development your field expects draws on the same method you have built here. A sport scientist, a coach, a sport manager and a therapist all keep improving the same way. The ability to take an experience, work out what it taught you, and act differently is what turns time spent into genuine development.
